description: ImageCAS 3-stage baseline: 3D U-Net (coarse) + 3D U-Net (dilated) + 3x 3D U-Net++ (patch 16/32/64). Zeng et al. CMIG 2023.

model.name: imagecas_baseline
model._checkpoints_comment: Delivered weights (Zenodo 21887809), staged 2026-08-31. NOTE: no Stage-1 coarse checkpoint was shipped -- only stage2_coarse_dilated and the three stage-3 patch nets. forward() uses coarse_net for the mask that stage 3 votes on, so this method cannot run until that file arrives or Stage 1 is trained locally with configs/imagecas_stage1_coarse.json. Do NOT point coarse_checkpoint at the dilated weights: Stage 1 is trained on the plain GT mask, Stage 2 on a dilated one. Same architecture, so it would load silently and be wrong.
